Issuing a Duplicate/Replacement SIM

Document ID: SOP_C05_SIM_REPLACEMENT

Category: C05 — SIM Card Services

Department: Customer Care

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To standardise the process for issuing a replacement SIM for lost, damaged, or swapped SIM cards while preventing fraudulent reissue.

Scope

Applies to all in-store and video-KYC based SIM replacement requests.

Procedure

Verify customer identity against KYC records (photo ID match, or video-KYC liveness check).

Confirm no active fraud flag exists on the account before proceeding.

Issue new SIM with same number; deactivate old SIM as part of the same transaction.

Instruct customer to restart device and confirm network registration before leaving the store / ending the session.

Log the replacement reason code (lost/damaged/swap/device change) in the CRM.

Exceptions

If fraud is suspected at any point, halt the process and route to SOP_C18_FRAUD_RESPONSE.
